-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Intercom API token and connectivity.

get-workspace.name: get-workspace
get-workspace.description: Get information about the connected Intercom workspace: name, region, timezone, and the authenticated admin.

search-conversations.name: search-conversations
search-conversations.description: Search conversations in Intercom with filters by state, date range, tags, and assignee. Returns paginated results with conversation metadata.

params.createdAfter: Unix timestamp — only conversations created after this time
params.createdBefore: Unix timestamp — only conversations created before this time

get-conversation.name: get-conversation
get-conversation.description: Get the full details of a specific Intercom conversation by ID, including all messages, notes, tags, and assignee.

reply-conversation.name: reply-conversation
reply-conversation.description: Reply to an Intercom conversation as an admin. Can send a public reply to the customer or add a private internal note.

params.body: The reply text (plain text or HTML)
params.type: "comment" sends a public reply to the customer; "note" adds a private internal note visible only to the team (default: comment)
params.adminId: The admin ID to reply as. If omitted, uses the token owner.

assign-conversation.name: assign-conversation
assign-conversation.description: Assign an Intercom conversation to a specific admin or team. Can also unassign by omitting both.

params.adminId: Admin ID to assign the conversation to
params.teamId: Team ID to assign the conversation to

update-conversation.name: update-conversation
update-conversation.description: Update a conversation state (open, close, snooze) or priority in Intercom.

params.snoozedUntil: Unix timestamp — required when state is "snoozed"

tag-conversation.name: tag-conversation
tag-conversation.description: Add or remove tags from an Intercom conversation.

params.tagIds: Tag IDs to add to the conversation
params.removeTagIds: Tag IDs to remove from the conversation

list-admins.name: list-admins
list-admins.description: List all admins (agents) in the Intercom workspace with their IDs, names, emails, and seat status.

list-teams.name: list-teams
list-teams.description: List all teams in the Intercom workspace with their IDs, names, and member counts.

list-tags.name: list-tags
list-tags.description: List all tags defined in the Intercom workspace. Useful for finding tag IDs before tagging conversations.

get-contact.name: get-contact
get-contact.description: Get details of an Intercom contact (user or lead) by their Intercom ID.

search-contacts.name: search-contacts
search-contacts.description: Search Intercom contacts by email, name, or phone number.

name: Intercom
description: Intercom customer support integration — manage conversations, tickets, contacts, and teams via the Intercom API.

changelog.notes: Initial release — search and reply to customer conversations, assign, tag, snooze, and look up contacts and teammates
